question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Destroy
solution:
The correct answer is option 2) i.e. 'Demolish'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Let's look at the** meaning **of the given word:

 
 
• Destroy- to damage something, esp. in a violent way, so that it can no longer be used or no longer exists.
 
 
 
• Let's look at the **meaning** of the correct answer:
 
 
• ​Demolish- to completely destroy a building, especially in order to use the land for something else.
 
 
 
• Clearly, the word 'Demolish' is closest in meaning to the given word 'Destroy'.
 
• Therefore, the correct synonym of the given word is 'Demolish'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
